entities.summary: August Heinrich Hoffmann was a German poet associated with the Young Germany movement. He is best known for writing "Das Lied der Deutschen", whose third stanza is now the national anthem of Germany, and a number of popular children's songs. August Heinrich Hoffmann von Fallersleben was a writers & intellectuals from Fallersleben (1798-04-02, Fallersleben–1874-01-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
